column2: The game's watch shows on the other players' left wrist, from the start of the game.
The game's watch shows on the left wrist of the player who has obtained it, not before.

Free position (Card, Rings or Strip): with the chat open (T), drag the HUD with the mouse and drop it where you want; the spot is kept. To go back to a fixed place: F10 › HUD, or Position in the HUD tab of Settings.
Chat bubbles: each message appears for a few seconds above the player who wrote it, readable up to 60 m. On by default, with every style; turn them off in F10 › HUD.
Add-on cars and the s21 quest car are controlled with the game's keys, the ones set in its options:
High beam: lights, then high beam, then off.
Left or right indicator; both together: hazard lights.
Starting: hold the key (ignition, then starter). With the engine running, one press stops it.
Car radio: aim at it, click to change station or turn it off, mouse wheel for the volume. With the ignition off, it goes silent.
Rev counter: temperature and fuel as bars, in its two windows.
40 L tank, with a warning when it's nearly empty. Filling up: engine off, car under 12 m from a pump, on foot next to it, hold the left click; 5 mk per litre, in cash.
Out of fuel far from anything: 4 s on the starter find the bottom of the tank.
Auto: by style · Free: drag it with the chat open
